item.title: Hand AI the Legwork, You Keep the Judgment
item.description: CTI teams can use AI agents to streamline intelligence workflows, reduce manual research and deliver faster insights. With the right guardrails, agents can provide source-backed assessments, flag intelligence gaps and show their reasoning, while keeping analysts in control of critical decisions.

item.title: Why is Italy a top target for cybercrime?
item.description: Italy ranks second worldwide for initial access offers. Our new blog looks at what that means for organizations everywhere.

item.title: Testing a PHP2Shell exploit in the era of AI-hallucinated PoCs
item.description: Intel 471 tested a public exploit for the AI-discovered PHP flaws. We found exploitation is hard, but you should still patch now.
